title: MEERA'S ENTRY
tod: 08:25 · morning sun has moved onto the window desks
logline: The episode's turning point for the heart of the story: a door opens, a girl enters, and one boy forgets how to sit still.
grade: Shift the white balance 200K warmer the moment she steps through the door, and hold it for the rest of the episode. The audience should feel it before they notice it.

narration.hi: क्लास के दरवाज़े पर एक अनजान चेहरा — जिसे देखकर लगा जैसे कमरे की हवा बदल गई हो।
narration.en: An unfamiliar face at the classroom door — and it felt as if the air in the room had changed.

narration.hi: उस वक़्त मुझे नहीं पता था कि उसका नाम मीरा है। और ये भी नहीं पता था कि उसकी दुनिया में पहले से कोई और है।
narration.en: At that moment I didn't know her name was Meera. Nor did I know that someone else was already in her world.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, on the classroom door from the front-side, door at frame-centre
shots.move: Static. The lesson continues in the background unbroken.
shots.action: The teacher is mid-sentence at the board. The door handle turns. Nobody reacts yet.
shots.expr: Ordinary. This flatness is the setup.
shots.env: L06 door: pale green, half-glass panel, a brass handle, a 'X-B' class plate.
shots.light: Corridor daylight leaking around the door edge — the only bright thing on a shadowed wall.
shots.vo: Line 1 at 12:04, one second after the handle turns.
shots.cont: The door opens INWARD toward the corridor (G-06). Never animate it opening into the room.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, from the back of the room, straight down the centre aisle
shots.move: Very slow push-in 0.15 m/s, straight, no pan.
shots.action: The door swings open and Meera stands in the frame, backlit into a silhouette, bag strap in both hands. Every head in the room turns.
shots.expr: Not yet readable — that is the point.
shots.env: Full classroom depth, centre aisle, blackboard far left.
shots.light: Corridor is 3 stops hotter than the room: she is a white shape with a dark edge. Deliberate blow-out.
shots.vfx: Subtle halation around her outline only.
shots.cont: Her silhouette proportions locked: long hair past mid-back, medium height (5'3"), straight posture.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.40 m, inside the room at the front, 3/4 on her as she enters
shots.move: Slight 10° arc left as she steps in, keeping her centred.
shots.action: She steps through, lets the door close behind her with one hand, adjusts the strap, and scans the room — left to right, then settles.
shots.expr: Composed nervousness. Chin level, small swallow, eyes doing all the work.
shots.env: Doorway, the front two rows soft in the foreground.
shots.light: Now lit properly: window key from frame-right on her cheek, corridor rim behind.
shots.cont: MEERA LOCK: 15–16, warm light-brown skin, long straight dark-brown hair past mid-back, side part with a small silver hairpin on her LEFT, almond dark eyes, thin brows, slim build. Uniform: white shirt, navy pinafore, thin maroon ribbon at the collar, black shoes, single silver stud earrings.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, 70 cm, eye-line, her face filling frame-right two-thirds
shots.move: Static with 1-px breathing. Hold longer than comfortable.
shots.action: She gives the class a small, genuine, slightly embarrassed smile; her eyes flick to an empty seat; she tucks a strand of hair behind her left ear.
shots.expr: The hair-tuck is the only 'performance' — everything else is restrained. Two blinks, no more.
shots.env: Background of students dissolving into warm bokeh.
shots.light: Window key, 3:1, catchlights in both eyes; the silver hairpin catches a specular spark.
shots.vfx: None. Do not soft-focus or glow her — she must look like a real girl in a real room.
shots.vo: Silence from 12:32 to 15:06 — almost three minutes with no narration at all. Trust the visuals.
shots.cont: Hairpin stays on her LEFT in every shot. Earrings silver studs only, both scenes.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, ISHAAN'S EYE LINE — camera placed at his seated eye height at bench 4
shots.move: Static. Slightly tighter than S06-04 to imply his attention narrowing.
shots.action: She is looking elsewhere now (toward the teacher). We watch her in profile, unaware of being watched.
shots.env: As above, but the background now includes the blackboard edge.
shots.light: Warm; her profile edge lit by the window.
shots.cont: POV LOCK: this framing must match S07-03's angle so the audience reads the same eyeline.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, at bench 4, 3/4 front on Ishaan
shots.move: Static. A single, tiny push of 0.05 m/s — almost subliminal.
shots.action: His pen has stopped. He realises his mouth is slightly open and closes it. He looks down at his notebook, then back up.
shots.expr: Caught. The eyes widen 10%, the brow lifts 2mm, and he actively tries to arrange his face into indifference. It does not work.
shots.env: Desk foreground, notebook with an unfinished line, pen held mid-stroke.
shots.light: Window key from behind-right; warm bounce lifts his eyes.
shots.vfx: None. No sparkles, no colour shift, no rose tint. This is the most important anti-cliché instruction in the episode.
shots.cont: Pen stops exactly 1 s before the cut. Notebook page number visible and consistent with S05-06.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, at bench 4, 3/4 on Kabir
shots.action: Kabir's eyes slide from Meera to Ishaan, then back, then to Ishaan. He bites his lip to stop the grin and raises one eyebrow.
shots.expr: Pure, delighted evil. Dimple visible on the LEFT cheek.
shots.env: Desk, Kabir's elbow in the foreground.
shots.light: Same warm key as S06-06 to keep the eyeline continuous.
shots.vo: Silence. This is the audience's own reaction, delivered by proxy.
shots.cont: CONT-EYELINE-02: Kabir sits on Ishaan's LEFT at bench 4, so Kabir looks RIGHT to see Meera and LEFT to see Ishaan — the mirror of Ishaan's look.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, from the front of the class, filming her walk down the aisle toward camera
shots.move: Static; she walks toward the lens and sits out of the bottom of the frame.
shots.action: She walks down the aisle past bench 4. As she passes, Ishaan's shoulder shifts slightly toward her and then pulls back.
shots.expr: She is looking ahead — she does not see him.
shots.env: Aisle, desks left and right, sun patches on the floor.
shots.light: She passes THROUGH a sun patch — a 12-frame warm flash across her uniform. Unrepeatable, so it must be beautiful.
shots.vo: Line 3 begins at 15:06 as she sits.
shots.cont: She sits at bench 2, two rows ahead of Ishaan, centre-left seat. Never change this seat.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, behind bench 4 looking forward, both boys in foreground, Meera's back in mid-ground
shots.move: Static. Slow 2 s push to end.
shots.action: Kabir leans in and mutters something; Ishaan shakes his head without looking at him. Meera, ahead, opens her notebook.
shots.expr: Ishaan: caught between defending himself and smiling. Kabir: triumphant.
shots.env: Three layers of depth: foreground boys, mid-ground Meera, deep background blackboard.
shots.light: Warm; the composition is the point
shots.vo: Line 3 finishes at 15:38, then silence to the cut.
shots.cont: Final image of Act II's opening: three people whose arrangement the entire series will be built on.
